grammar.summary: 本课介绍瑞典的司法特派员制度，集中运用了被动语态、定语从句与名词性从句。课文大量使用被动语态客观叙述调查过程，用定语从句补充修饰官员与投诉，用 that/whether 引导的名词性从句充当主语或宾语，使制度说明条理清晰。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: 当突出动作的承受者或不需指明执行者时用被动语态 be + 过去分词。本课用被动语态叙述制度的「被采纳」、投诉「被书面提出」、警察「被斥责」等，使叙述客观严谨。

examples.en: The system has worked so well, that it has been adopted in other countries too.
examples.cn: 由于这种制度行之有效，已被其他国家采纳。

examples.en: The policeman in question was severely reprimanded and was informed that if any further complaints were lodged against him, he would prosecuted.
examples.cn: 当事的警察受到严厉的斥责，并被告知，如果再有人投诉他，他将受到起诉。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 who/that/which 引导定语从句修饰先行词并补充信息。本课用 who 修饰 person（调查者），用 that 修饰 complaints（投诉），使长句信息完整。

examples.en: A parliamentary committee representing all political parties appoints a person who is suitably qualified to investigate private grievances against the State.
examples.cn: 议会内有一个代表各政党利益的委员会，由它委派一位称职的人选专门调查个人对国家的意见。

examples.en: The Ombudsman's prompt action at once put an end to an unpleasant practice which might have gone unnoticed.
examples.cn: 司法特派员及时采取的行动，迅速制止了这一起不愉快的事件，不然这件事可能因未得到人们注意而不了了之。

points.title: 名词性从句 (Noun Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 that/whether 引导的从句可充当主语、宾语或表语。本课用 that 从句作宾语表示「认识到」的内容，用 that 引导同位语从句解释 belief 的具体内容，使表述严密。

examples.en: The Swedes were the first to recognize that public official like civil servants, police officers, health inspectors or tax-collectors can make mistakes or act over-zealously in the belief that they are serving the public.
examples.cn: 是瑞典人首先认识到政府工作人员如文职人员、警官、卫生稽查员、税务人员等等也会犯错误或者自以为在为公众服务而把事情做过了头。

examples.en: A foreigner living in a Swedish village wrote to the Ombudsman complaining that he had been ill-treated by the police, simply because he was a foreigner.
examples.cn: 一个住在瑞典乡村的外国人写信给司法特派员，抱怨说他受到警察的虐待，原因就是因为他是个外国人。

exercises.q: The system has worked so well, that it ______ in other countries too.
A parliamentary committee...appoints a person ______ is suitably qualified to investigate private grievances against the State.
The Swedes were the first to recognize that public official...can make mistakes or act over-zealously in the belief ______ they are serving the public.

用被动语态填空：As complaints must be made in writing, the Ombudsman receives an average of 1,200 letters a year. He has eight lawyer assistants to help him and examines every single letter in detail. There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work for his correspondence is open to public ______ (inspect).（写出 inspect 的正确名词相关形式，课文用词为 inspection）
课文中 The Ombudsman's prompt action 中 prompt 的含义最接近？
